description: Hvana wears a blue floor-length wool overdress with a low square neckline, elbow sleeves, restrained woven borders and two round shoulder brooches. An ivory linen shift appears through the modest front skirt opening and below the sleeves. A woven belt with a circular buckle and a narrow hanging panel secures the waist, while a brown bordered wrap drapes along both forearms. Both brown leather boots are visible below the hem.
